conf.description: IBM Guardium DAM audit-report-exports, syslog-cef: the CEF-over-syslog push variant of the audit report (one CEF record per report row). The extension key names are derived per report from the CSV/CEF File Label and the task's chosen column set rather than a fixed vendor schema, so this pipeline generically strips the syslog/CEF wrapper and kv-extracts whatever keys are present; it deliberately does not force per-report keys onto ECS/custom targets because there is no stable key list to map against (see README gaps).

conf.comment: Audit report exported as CEF-over-syslog instead of pulled CSV. Extension keys vary per report/task; do not assume the policy-violation alert's fixed cs/act/msg schema here.

functions.description: Peel the Guardium syslog header hostname and locate the CEF record
Split the CEF pipe-delimited header into its positional fields (fixed by the CEF spec regardless of report) and isolate the extension blob

Generic space-delimited kv extraction of the extension, since the key set is not fixed per report; a free-text value with unescaped spaces (this report's equivalent of Full SQL String) can be truncated by this generic split — a known limitation with no fixed-schema alternative (see README)
The Guardium appliance hostname is the one field whose meaning is stable across every report

If the extension happens to carry the common CEF rt convention, use it for _time; otherwise _time is left to Cribl's receipt time (documented gap: no fixed timestamp key across reports); tag event.dataset; drop pure staging fields
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
